home.intro: A starter storefront rendering live data from the Store API. Every brand app is generated from this template and overrides tokens, slots and route files — never the shared kit.

offline.title: Store API not reachable
offline.body: The storefront could not load GET /store. Start the Prism mock with `pnpm mock` (or the whole stack with `pnpm dev`) and reload.
offline.config: The client reads STORE_API_URL, falling back to MOCK_API_URL and then http://localhost:4010.

plp.empty: No products match these filters. Try clearing the search or choosing another category.
plp.metaDescription: Browse the full catalogue: filter by category, search, and sort by price or newest.

pdp.chooseOption: Choose an option before adding to the cart.

payment.title: How would you like to pay?
payment.manualBody: Phase 1 placeholder — the manual provider. Card payment arrives with hosted fields, so card data never reaches this app.
payment.failed: Payment was not authorised. Choose a payment method and try again.

review.title: Review your order
review.idempotencyNote: Placing the order sends an idempotency key, so a retry after a network error cannot create a second order.
